name: Ontology Design & Validation Stabilization
description: Stabilize qa-sdk ontology design and validation by defining local validation contracts, documentation graph requirements, allocation invariants, and handoff boundaries before implementing registry-service persistence or index-meta sync.

userStories.title: Consolidate Ontology Validation Scope
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want a clear validation scope map so that agents know which documents, packages, and gates must be checked before changing ontology design.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update a spec/guide section that names the validation boundary for ontology design changes.
The boundary distinguishes definition-catalog validation, operational-ontology allocation validation, programming-artifact simulation validation, and registry-service/index-meta lifecycle validation.
The boundary states that registry-service/index-meta implementation is not required for local validation stories.
Relevant docs include `sources` pointing to implementation/test files where applicable.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Define Allocation Validation Contract
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want allocation validation requirements written as a contract so that future registry persistence work preserves the current local allocation invariants.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current `allocateOntologyAddressSpace()` and `validateOntologyAddressAllocationPlan()` invariants.
Cover duplicate prefix/version allocation, missing taxonomy axis, product allocation, and sum segment allocation.
State which invariants belong to `operational-ontology` and which are deferred to registry-service persistence.
Link the contract to `docs/specs/operational-ontology/operational-ontology-registry-allocation.todo.md`.
Existing allocation tests remain the executable source of truth.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Add Validation Matrix for Ontology Design Changes
userStories.description: As an ontology maintainer, I want a scenario matrix for ontology design changes so that each kind of change has a known validation path.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a matrix covering axis changes, taxonomy changes, relation/category changes, allocation policy changes, definition graph changes, and pack activation changes.
Each matrix row lists required docs, code owners, tests, and commands.
Core gate changes require impact analysis or escalation guidance rather than silent local edits.
The matrix references the 5Q checklist for new axes.
The matrix explicitly separates local validation from registry-service/index-meta activation.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Reorganize Registry Allocation TODO into Executable Phases
userStories.description: As a ralph-tui planner, I want the large registry allocation TODO split into execution phases so that each phase can become a small agent task.
acceptanceCriteria: Group open TODO items into persistence schema, store adapter, service layer, index-meta sync, activation smoke, and prefix policy phases.
Each phase has a short goal, non-goals, prerequisites, and validation commands.
Cross-phase dependencies are explicit.
Phase 2 persistence tasks do not depend on implementing Phase 4 index-meta sync.
The original TODO intent is preserved; no open item is silently removed.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Stabilize Definition Graph Requirements for Ontology Modules
userStories.description: As a documentation maintainer, I want ontology module docs to have explicit graph requirements so that contains/link drift is caught before implementation starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Define required frontmatter fields for ontology module, leaf, plan, todo, and knowledge docs.
Define when module docs must include `contains` links.
Define when leaf docs should split before exceeding 150 lines.
Document how `sources` should point from specs to implementation and tests.
`def validate` reports no warnings after the documentation updates.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Add Local Validation Fixture for Allocation Drift
userStories.description: As an ontology implementer, I want a targeted local fixture for allocation drift so that invalid allocation plans fail before registry persistence exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or extend an operational-ontology test fixture for allocation drift.
The fixture covers at least one prefix/version collision.
The fixture covers at least one taxonomy-axis mismatch.
The fixture returns structured validation errors that identify the offending prefix, taxonomy, or axis.
The fixture does not require registry-service or index-meta.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.

userStories.title: Specify Registry-Service Persistence Handoff
userStories.description: As a future registry-service implementer, I want a handoff spec for ontology persistence so that DB schema work starts from stable local contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the persistence records expected for namespace, axis, taxonomy, allocation, and allocation segment.
Map each persistence record back to local allocation model fields.
State duplicate/collision rules that must be enforced at store or service level.
Identify which tests should be added under `registry-service` when persistence begins.
Keep actual DB schema implementation out of this story unless explicitly selected in a follow-up PRD.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.
If registry-service code is changed, `pnpm --filter registry-service test` passes.

userStories.title: Specify Index-Meta Sync Handoff
userStories.description: As a future index-meta implementer, I want a sync handoff spec so that active ontology allocations can later materialize into prefix registry and schema version records.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what data active allocation must send to index-meta.
Distinguish product allocation, sum allocation, and segment materialization.
State idempotency and collision expectations for sync.
Define minimum activation smoke checks.
Keep actual index-meta sync implementation out of this story unless explicitly selected in a follow-up PRD.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.
If index-meta code is changed, `pnpm --filter index-meta test` passes.

userStories.title: Define Catalog Scoped Prefix Decision Criteria
userStories.description: As an ontology architect, I want scoped prefix decision criteria so that prefix namespace changes are not made before there is a concrete need.
acceptanceCriteria: Write decision criteria for retaining global prefix uniqueness versus introducing scoped prefixes.
Include scenarios involving catalog id, ontology id, tenant boundary, and pack collisions.
List affected surfaces: `/prefixes/:prefix`, index-meta key shape, decode-service/cache keys, and migration plan.
State that registry-service prefix table schema must not change until this decision is resolved.
If a new decision doc is created, it links back to the registry allocation TODO.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology typecheck` passes.
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology build` passes.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` passes.
